config.reasoning_rationale: Sokoban's answer is ONE LETTER. A thinking model puts deliberation where the answer belongs and the ceiling eats it -- measured on the same weights: 2314 tokens and no commitment. This cabinet is the one-letter case, so the setting is off. MISSILE COMMAND is the same case (one integer). DARTS is the opposite (exact checkout arithmetic), and a harness that proves the SHAPE should be able to prove it at either setting -- so it takes this as a PARAMETER rather than a constant.
